description:
We are a diverse team of four with some skills in; coding, biology, physics, chemistry. We are willing to work with other small team of two people wherever you are. We are in the search for the weirdest and less expected places around our little blue planet. 

Feel free to reach out!
summary: Our project aims to find places on Earth that have environments similar to the Moon and Mars. We research and compare environmental conditions such as temperature, sunlight, UV radiation, dryness and terrain. Using NASA data and scientific research, we identify locations on Earth that share similar characteristics with these space environments. Our goal is to find meaningful Earth-based examples that can help us understand the challenges of future lunar and Mars exploration. This project is important because studying similar environments on Earth can help researchers prepare for future space missions and understand how humans and equipment may cope with these extreme conditions.
details:
Our project explores the environments of the Moon and Mars and compares them with similar places on Earth.

We use NASA data to investigate temperatures and environmental conditions, particularly at the lunar South Pole. We use Python, Jupyter Notebook and Pandas to analyse temperature data, calculate Q1, median and Q3, and identify extremely cold areas.

We also research Mars and compare its temperature, atmosphere and surface conditions with the Moon and Earth.

We focus on similarities such as extreme cold, strong UV radiation, dryness and isolated environments. Our aim is to identify Earth locations that could help us understand the challenges of future lunar and Mars exploration.

Our project combines space data and Earth-based environmental research to make these comparisons using scientific evidence.
